title: Rory and the Velvet Fern Glade
verses:
The evening was quiet, the forest grew still,
As darkness rolled over the high sleepy hill.
And Rory walked slow through the cool velvet moss,
Where soft little shadows were floating across.

Then Ricky hopped over a long fallen log,
And listened to croaks from a cozy green frog.
While Nia flew down from her nest in the tree,
As happy and calm as a dino could be.

Now Tilly brought clover for everyone's snack,
With Psittaco riding right high on her back.
Then Psittaco chirped as he tucked in his wings,
And listened to tunes that the night-cricket sings.

Benny laid down near the bright silver stream,
And drifted right into a magical dream.
The water washed over the smooth river stones,
With soft hums that settled right deep in their bones.

Then Rory yawned big as the stars came in sight,
And wrapped all his friends in the warm yellow light.
They cuddled together on pillows of green,
The quietest night that had ever been seen.

The moon showed its face in a sky soft and deep,
And held the whole valley in wonderful sleep.
So close your eyes now as the starlight shines clear,
For Rory is resting and bedtime is here.
